lines.name: Hexa
lines.text: Welcome back. I kept your seat warm. Remember when I told you how your liver stores sugar and keeps your blood sugar steady?

lines.name: Hexa
lines.text: I can feel 4 sugar crumbs hiding in this world’s corners. Steer Moss Leaf right up to one and she gobbles it.

lines.name: Hexa
lines.text: Your liver stores sugar as glycogen and releases it between meals and overnight to keep your blood sugar steady.
